answer: Unpredictable per-identity puzzles block precompute: each epoch seeds a unique prompt no one can cache, so a fake must compose original work live, not replay a stored answer. Like shale split to a fresh seam every time, the task never repeats; its layout is a new nebula of words, and no bank of pre-made quartz-hard responses helps. Ten thousand clones each face ten thousand distinct problems, so bulk fakery gains no scale economy.
